summary: sextant-cli-darwin-amd64 ships a Go binary that connects a local PTY to a hardcoded remote WebSocket relay
details: The darwin/amd64 binary at bin/sxt dials a hardcoded WebSocket relay at wss://relay.sextant.top and wires network-received bytes into a local PTY via github.com/creack/pty and github.com/coder/websocket, with pion WebRTC/TURN peer channels as an additional transport. This gives the operator of relay.sextant.top interactive shell/command control on the installer's host. The same binary queries http://ip-api.com/json/ for the installer's country, city, timezone, and public IP, identifying the host to the relay operator. The binary also embeds Claude Code and Gemini CLI internals (CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, bin/claude, claude.localhost, @google/gemini-cli, api.anthropic.com/v1/models, SKILL.md), and package.json declares its license as 'SEE LICENSE IN https://github.com/ddos798/claude_control' — the publisher-declared repository name and the in-binary targeting of the local AI CLI environment indicate the remote channel is designed to drive the installer's Claude Code / Gemini CLI sessions.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
